```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2) 
```
#DeSeq2 
## Upload sampledata and order it 
```{r setup{}
# Read data with filtered number of reads, at least 2 replicates and no misclustered samples
sampleData <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/filtered_data_wo_misclustered_wo_traps_2_repl_with_ds_controls.txt", header=T)
# Join sample data with filtered data
#Reorder in alphabetic order
sampleData<- sampleData[order(sampleData$Sample_id),] 
#Make rownames acession names
rownames(sampleData) <- sampleData$Sample_id
sampleData <- as.data.frame(sampleData)
#sampleData <- na.omit(sampleData)
```


## Import salmon data 
```{r}
library(tximport)

# Base directory for Salmon outputs
salmon_base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/005_quant/all_plates_96w_salmon_tair10/"

# Dynamically construct paths for each sample in sampleData$Sample
sample_paths <- file.path(salmon_base_dir, sampleData$Sample_id)

# List all quant.sf files within these sample paths
files <- file.path(sample_paths, "quant.sf")

# Check which files exist
existing_files <- files[file.exists(files)]

# Extract sample IDs for the existing files
fileSampleIDs <- basename(dirname(existing_files))

# Create a named vector for tximport: names are sample IDs
names(existing_files) <- fileSampleIDs

# Perform tximport for Salmon quantification
txi.salmon <- tximport(existing_files, type = "salmon", tx2gene = tx2gene)

# View a summary of the imported data
summary(txi.salmon)
# Filter sampledata 
filteredSampleData <- sampleData[sampleData$Sample_id %in% fileSampleIDs, ]
rownames(filteredSampleData) <- filteredSampleData$Sample_id


##Subset txi salmon
sampleNames <- rownames(filteredSampleData)

# Subset the txi.salmon object based on the sample names
txi.salmon$counts <- txi.salmon$counts[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.salmon$abundance <- txi.salmon$abundance[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.salmon$length <- txi.salmon$length[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
```
### LIMMA+VOOM QUANTIFICATION ###
## Filtering based on number of reads 
```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
## Remove genes with 0 counts
# Import counts and set column names
counts <- txi.salmon$counts
colnames(counts) <- make.unique(paste(filteredSampleData$Genotype, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Accession, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Replicate,
                                     filteredSampleData$Request_id, sep="_"))

# Remove all-zero genes
nonzero <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 0, ]

# Create DGEList object
d0 <- DGEList(nonzero)

# Create group indicators based on variant
variant <- as.factor(filteredSampleData$Variant)
group1 <- variant == "ddm1"  # ddm1 samples
group2 <- variant == "Col"  # Col0 samples

# Keep genes expressed in at least 20% of either group
keep <- (rowSums(cpm(d0)[,group1] > 1) >= sum(group1)*0.1) | 
        (rowSums(cpm(d0)[,group2] > 1) >= sum(group2)*0.1)

# Filter the DGEList
d0_filtered <- d0[keep,]

# Calculate normalization factors
d0_filtered <- calcNormFactors(d0_filtered)

# Print summary
cat("Total genes before filtering:", nrow(d0), "\n")
cat("Genes retained after filtering:", nrow(d0_filtered), "\n")
cat("Percentage retained:", round(nrow(d0_filtered)/nrow(d0)*100, 1), "%\n")

# Before filtering
log_cpm_before <- cpm(d0, log=TRUE)
# After filtering
log_cpm_after <- cpm(d0_filtered, log=TRUE, prior.count = 1)

# Plot density distributions
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(density(log_cpm_before), main="Before filtering", xlab="log2 CPM")
plot(density((log_cpm_after)), main="After filtering", xlab="log2 CPM")
```

```{r}
## Get misclustered samples based on the PCA
```

### ### ### ### ### ### ### ### #
### Find misclustered samples ###
### ### ### ### ### ### ### ### #
```{r}
normalized_counts_raw <- log_cpm_after_TEs_PCA
colnames(normalized_counts_raw) <- paste(filteredSampleData$Plate, filteredSampleData$Accession, filteredSampleData$Variant, filteredSampleData$Sample_id, sep = "_")

## Subset to TEs
tes <- grepl("AT[1-9]TE", rownames(normalized_counts_raw))
##Extract all  TEs from data
normalized_counts_raw <- normalized_counts_raw[tes,]

# Load required libraries
library(pheatmap)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# Assuming normalized_counts_raw is your CPM-normalized count matrix
colnames(normalized_counts_raw) <- paste(filteredSampleData$Request_id, 
                                         filteredSampleData$Accession, 
                                         filteredSampleData$Variant, 
                                         filteredSampleData$Sample_id, sep = "_")

# Split samples by plate from filteredSampleData
plates <- unique(filteredSampleData$Request_id)

# Initialize list to store the tables for each plate
clustering_tables <- list()
heatmap_list <- list()
filteredSampleData <- sampleData[sampleData$Sample_id %in% fileSampleIDs, ]
rownames(filteredSampleData) <- filteredSampleData$Sample_id 


# Loop through each plate
for (plate in plates) {
  
  # Subset normalized counts by plate
  plate_samples <- filteredSampleData$Request_id == plate
  plate_counts <- normalized_counts_raw[, plate_samples]
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix for samples in this plate
  correlation_matrix <- cor(plate_counts)
  
  # Perform hierarchical clustering on the correlation matrix
  clustering <- hclust(as.dist(1 - correlation_matrix), method = "average")
  
  # Cut the tree to form two clusters
  clusters <- cutree(clustering, k = 2)
  
  # Generate a clustering table for the current plate
  clustering_table <- data.frame(Sample = names(clusters), Cluster = clusters)
  clustering_tables[[paste("Plate", plate)]] <- clustering_table
  
  # Generate heatmap with ComplexHeatmap
  heatmap <- Heatmap(correlation_matrix,
                     name = "Correlation",
                     row_dend_side = "left",
                     column_dend_side = "top",
                     clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                     clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
                     clustering_method_rows = "average",
                     clustering_method_columns = "average",
                     show_row_names = TRUE,
                     show_column_names = TRUE,
                     row_split = clusters,  # Split rows based on clustering
                     column_split = clusters,  # Split columns based on clustering
                     top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
                       Genotype = filteredSampleData$Variant[plate_samples],
                       col = list(Genotype = c("Col" = "#000B58", 
                                                "ddm1" = "#FA812F"))
                                              #"ct_col" = "lightblue",
                                              #"ddm1_ct" = "darkred"))
                     ),
                     col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#133E87", "white", "#AF1740")),
                     # Adjust row and column name text size
                     row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5),  # Adjust row names size (default: 10)
                     column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5), # Adjust column names size (default: 10)
                     # Rotate column names if necessary
                     column_names_rot = 45,  # Rotate column names by 45 degrees
                     show_heatmap_legend = TRUE)
  
  # Store each heatmap object in the list with the plate name
  heatmap_list[[paste("Plate", plate)]] <- heatmap
}

# Print the clustering tables
clustering_tables

# Draw a specific heatmap 
draw(heatmap_list[["Plate 17224"]], annotation_legend_side = "bottom")

```
## Write misclustered samples
```{r}
# Combine the clustering results into one data frame
clusters_samples <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, clustering_tables))
names(clusters_samples) <- c("Sample", "Cluster")

# Mutate the data frame to extract Plate, Accession, Variant, and ID from the Sample name
clusters_samples <- clusters_samples %>%
  mutate(
    Plate = sapply(strsplit(Sample, "_"), `[`, 1),  # Extract the first part before the first '_'
    Accession = sapply(strsplit(Sample, "_"), `[`, 2),  # Extract the second part
    Variant = sapply(strsplit(Sample, "_"), `[`, 3),  # Extract the third part
    ID = sapply(strsplit(Sample, "_"), `[`, 4)  # Extract the fourth part
  )

# Write the results to a CSV file
write.csv2(clusters_samples, "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/limma_output/hclust_samples_assigned.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
